title: Jennifer Winget Shares Unseen Haldi Photos on Friendship Day, Calls Herself 'the Luckiest'
excerpt: The actress posted candid pictures from her pre-wedding haldi ceremony on July 4, featuring husband William Ishmael and close friends Karan Wahi and Harleen Sethi, marking the occasion with a heartfelt Friendship Day tribute.
body:
• Jennifer Winget shared previously unseen photos from her haldi ceremony, held in India on July 4, as a Friendship Day tribute on August 3.
  • The pictures feature Winget with husband William Ishmael and close friends Karan Wahi and Harleen Sethi, with the actress calling herself "the luckiest."
  • The couple married in a private Christian ceremony in West Wales, UK, on July 16, with Winget wearing a custom gown by Karleo Fashion.
  • Winget has been gradually sharing moments from her wedding celebrations, after keeping the entire affair under wraps for weeks.

Television star Jennifer Winget gave fans their first official look at her pre-wedding haldi ceremony on Sunday, sharing a set of unseen photographs on Instagram to mark Friendship Day. The actress, who married Singapore-based businessman William Ishmael in an intimate UK ceremony on July 16, captioned the post with a thank-you note to her friends and called herself "the luckiest."

The pictures show Winget surrounded by close friends, including actors Karan Wahi and Harleen Sethi, at what was a closely guarded celebration. According to Hindustan Times, the haldi took place in India on July 4 — nearly two weeks before the couple flew to the UK for their church wedding.

A Ceremony Kept Under Wraps

The haldi function had been the subject of intense speculation since mid-July, when unverified images from what appeared to be a pre-wedding celebration began circulating online. At the time, neither Winget nor Ishmael confirmed the event, and no official pictures were released. Reports from India Forums and Bollywood Hungama noted that the ceremony was "organised in complete secrecy."

That secrecy has been the defining feature of Winget's wedding story. The couple had quietly planned their celebrations for months, with only close friends and family in the loop. Industry sources told Moneycontrol earlier this year that Winget had "put together an elaborate mood board" and was personally shortlisting vendors, while keeping the details out of the public eye.

"Thank you for planning this day."

— Jennifer Winget, in her Friendship Day Instagram post

From Haldi in India to Wedding in Wales

After the haldi on July 4, the couple travelled to the United Kingdom, where they exchanged vows at a venue in West Wales on July 16. Winget wore a classic white strapless wedding gown by Karleo Fashion, featuring delicate hand embroidery, beadwork, and — according to eagle-eyed fans — a design detail incorporating her dogs. Ishmael paired a formal blue tuxedo with the occasion.

The first official wedding video, set to Taylor Swift's "Lover," arrived on July 18, when Winget captioned an Instagram reel: "and finally our stars aligned." The video showed the couple walking down the aisle, exchanging rings, and sharing their first kiss as a married couple, against the backdrop of the English countryside. Celebrities including Genelia Deshmukh, Drashti Dhami, Rashami Desai, and Sonu Sood congratulated the couple in the comments.

A second batch of wedding photos followed days later, with the caption: "Home was never a place, because you were always my home." Those images included William feeding Jennifer cake and the couple silhouetted against a sunset, according to Zoom TV.

The Friendship at the Heart of It

Sunday's haldi reveal carried a distinctly personal note. Winget chose Friendship Day — celebrated on the first Sunday of August — to publicly thank the friends who helped plan and attend the ceremony. Karan Wahi, her co-star from Dill Mill Gayye and Raisinghani vs Raisinghani, and Harleen Sethi, her close friend from the television industry, both featured prominently in the pictures.

Wahi and Winget's friendship stretches back nearly two decades to their early television days. Earlier this year, wedding rumours briefly linked the two romantically — a suggestion Wahi dismissed on Instagram with the quip: "Free ki PR ke liye bahut shukriya."

What's Next for Jennifer Winget

Winget, 41, is one of Indian television's most recognizable faces, known for roles in Kasautii Zindagii Kay, Beyhadh, Bepannaah, and Code M. She was previously married to actor Karan Singh Grover; the couple divorced in 2014. Ishmael, a finance professional who holds a degree in Economics and Finance from the University of York, currently serves as Director of Business Development and Trading at MHC Digital Group in Singapore.

On the professional front, Winget is reportedly attached to an upcoming Netflix mystery thriller alongside Parineeti Chopra and Tahir Raj Bhasin. With the wedding celebrations now winding down and fans still hoping for more pictures, her gradual, carefully timed reveals have turned what could have been a single-day news cycle into weeks of sustained attention — a strategy that has proved as effective off-screen as her performances on it.
nri_angle: Jennifer Winget is a major figure in Indian television, and her wedding to a Singapore-based finance professional resonates with the global Indian diaspora.
